result.instructions: Tools for Raisely, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Raisely data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run raisely_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run raisely_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run raisely_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. raisely_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: raisely_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Raisely API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the base, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/subscriptions/{uuid}/donations" or "/donations?limit=50". Returns the parsed JSON.

path.description: Full API path after the base, starting with "/", e.g. "/donations?limit=50".

tools.name: create_donation
tools.title: Record a donation
tools.description: MUTATES Raisely data: records a donation (use for OFFLINE/manual donations — e.g. cash or cheque). Raisely API: POST /donations with the body wrapped as { data: {...} }. Required by the API: amount (integer, in cents/smallest currency unit), currency (3-letter code), email (donor), type (ONLINE or OFFLINE), method (payment gateway, e.g. OFFLINE). Link it to a campaign/profile via campaignUuid/profileUuid. Everything else (firstName, lastName, message, date, items, public, private, ...) goes through `fields`. Returns the created donation.

amount.description: Total donation amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents). Required.

currency.description: 3-letter currency code, e.g. AUD, USD, GBP. Required.

email.description: Email address of the donor. Required.

type.description: ONLINE or OFFLINE (default OFFLINE — this tool is for manual/offline donations).

method.description: The payment gateway/method, e.g. "OFFLINE", "CREDIT". Required by the API.

campaignUuid.description: Uuid of the campaign the donation belongs to.

profileUuid.description: Uuid of the fundraising profile the donation is credited to.

fields.description: Additional documented Raisely fields to send in the JSON write body's `data` object — merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: upsert_user
tools.title: Upsert a user
tools.description: MUTATES Raisely data: creates OR updates a supporter/donor, matched by email (safer than a plain create — no duplicates). Raisely API: POST /users/upsert with the body wrapped as { data: {...} }. Typed: email (the match key), firstName, lastName; everything else (phoneNumber, address, public, private, ...) via `fields`. Returns the upserted user.

email.description: The user's email address — the match key for upsert. Required.

fields.description: Additional documented Raisely fields to send in the JSON write body's `data` object — merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.title: Update a fundraising profile
tools.description: MUTATES Raisely data: updates a fundraising profile's goal/name/story. Raisely API: PATCH /profiles/{path} with the body wrapped as { data: {...} } (only included fields change). Use `fields` for goal, name, description/story, public, private, and any other documented field. Set overwriteCustomFields:true to overwrite (rather than preserve) unspecified custom fields. The path is never sent in the body.

path.description: The profile path (URL slug) or uuid to update (path only; required).

goal.description: New fundraising goal (in the smallest currency unit).

overwriteCustomFields.description: When true, overwrite (instead of preserve) custom fields not included in this update.

fields.description: Additional documented Raisely fields to send in the JSON write body's `data` object — merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: create_post
tools.title: Create a post
tools.description: MUTATES Raisely data: publishes a post (a campaign/profile update). Raisely API: POST /posts with the body wrapped as { data: {...} }. Required by the API: path (the post's URL slug), body (the content), photoUrl. Link it to a profile via profileUuid (pass through `fields`). Extra fields (title, date, ...) via `fields`. Returns the created post.

path.description: The post's URL slug/path. Required by the API.

body.description: The post content/body. Required by the API.

photoUrl.description: URL of the post's photo. Required by the API.

fields.description: Additional documented Raisely fields to send in the JSON write body's `data` object — merged OVER the typed fields above.
